facts.claim: Grace Hotel Santorini (Auberge Resorts Collection), Imerovigli, Santorini 84700 (address on the Weddings page). Hosts weddings: page titled 'Weddings at Grace Hotel'; 'Santorini elegance, exquisite clifftop setting'; 'Perched on an ancient clifftop above the azure Aegean Sea'. Venue type: cliff-top suite hotel.

Grace Hotel caldera wording (exact): 'Say “I do” against a sweeping Mediterranean backdrop in the most impressive villa in the Cyclades Islands, or choose from a variety of stunning venues with the perfect perch to witness the island’s famous caldera sunsets.' Also: the unity ceremony 'will take place 363 meters above sea level surrounded by uninterrupted ocean views'.

Grace Hotel wedding spaces as published: The Villa (400 sq m, private pool, gazebo, outdoor fireplace on a split-level terrace; 'amongst the largest of the Cyclades Islands') seated 15 / standing 60; 363 Lounge (open-air champagne lounge terrace on the hotel's second level 'directly facing the island’s famous sunset') seated 40 / standing 60. Couples may exchange vows on the villa terrace.
Grace Hotel standout: a unity ceremony in which the couple combine black and white volcanic sand collected together from Santorini beaches.

Grace Hotel: a flat venue fee applies and includes exclusive use of the selected event spaces; terms differ for 50 guests or fewer (includes a wedding arbor) and over 50 guests. Amount not recorded. Guests may book rooms individually; room block or resort buyout quoted by the Sales Manager; 'We do not require a minimum of accommodations to be booked.' Total room count not published on the Weddings page.

Grace Hotel: a wedding planner is required for all weddings, involved for a minimum of 3 months before; the hotel provides a dedicated event manager. A DJ or live band may play at the reception; a private lounge with full-length mirror is available to the wedding party from 8am.

Astra Suites, Imerovigli, Santorini: 'a luxury all-suite accommodation hotel in Imerovigli, famous for honeymoons, weddings and sunset views' (site description). Home page wedding section: 'The Wedding of your life with Astra Suites ... the breathtaking scenery alone will make your Santorini wedding a once in a lifetime experience' with a 'reserve a day' link. Venue type: cliffside all-suite boutique hotel.

Astra Suites caldera wording (exact): 'With mesmerising views of the caldera and Santorini’s famed sunsets'; Standard Suites have 'spacious terraces and unhindered views of the caldera'; restaurant: 'The unobstructed view of the caldera.'

Astra Suites rooms as published: Standard Suites, Luxury Suites (including pool and infinity pool suites) and Villas; the Astra Private Villa is about 500 m from the main hotel complex in Imerovigli, 'with outstanding, unobstructed caldera views'. Standout: a cliff-side infinity pool. Wedding capacity, ceremony options, exclusive use and total room count not published on the page read (astrasuites.com/weddings/ redirects to the home page).

Le Ciel Santorini (leciel-santorini.com), a dedicated wedding and events venue: 'Le Ciel is the perfect setting to exchange your vows'; site sections for Weddings, Ceremonies and Full Day. Venue type: event venue with restaurant (indoor and outdoor seating and a bar).

Le Ciel caldera wording (exact): 'Scenic views: Le Ciel Santorini offers panoramic views of the Aegean Sea and the famous Caldera cliffs, making it a truly breathtaking location for a wedding.' Spaces: 'spacious open air terrace and indoor areas'; 'several outdoor spaces, such as terraces, balconies, and gardens'.

Le Ciel standout: 'easy access from the road and around Le Ciel, with very few steps and wheelchair ramps'; the team of more than 30 employees includes a DJ and security guards. Capacity, ceremony types, rooms and exclusive-use terms not published on the pages read; the village/area is not stated on the pages read.

Katikies Events page lists Katikies Chromata Santorini in Imerovigli with wedding-ceremony spaces: Koukoumavlos Restaurant Deck (seated 20 / standing 50, 'Ideal for wedding ceremonies'), Katikies Lounge (seated 20 / standing 30, wedding ceremonies), Chromata Pool Bar area (seated 40-50 / standing 50, wedding ceremonies), Villa Chromata (standing 30, private parties). The Events page does not state a caldera view for Chromata (does not qualify in this batch).

insider_details.detail: Imerovigli's cliff-top wedding spaces are small: Grace's two spaces seat 40 and 15, so a seated dinner above about 40 needs a second venue or a larger property; plan guest numbers before shortlisting.
Grace requires an independent wedding planner engaged at least 3 months out, so budget planner time from the booking date, not just the wedding week.
For guests with limited mobility, ask each cliffside venue about steps; Le Ciel is the only venue in this batch that states road access, very few steps and wheelchair ramps.
Astra Suites publishes no wedding capacity or ceremony terms online, so treat it as an intimate or elopement option and confirm numbers with the hotel before promising guests rooms.
